runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        repository: actualbudget/actions
        path: actions
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: 18
    - name: Install dependencies
      shell: bash
      run: |
        cd actions/release-notes
        echo '::group::npm ci'
        npm ci
        echo '::endgroup::'

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actualbudget/actions/setup@main
    - name: Generate release notes
      id: generate
      shell: bash
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: node actions/release-notes/generate/index.js
    - name: Find Comment
      uses: peter-evans/find-comment@v2
      id: fc
      with:
        issue-number: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.pr_number }}
        body-includes: auto-generated-release-notes
    - name: Create Comment
      if: ${{ steps.fc.outputs.comment-id == 0 }}
      uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v2
      with:
        issue-number: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.pr_number }}
        body: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.comment }}
    - name: Update Comment
      if: ${{ steps.fc.outputs.comment-id != 0 }}
      uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v2
      with:
        comment-id: ${{ steps.fc.outputs.comment-id }}
        edit-mode: replace
        body: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.comment }}

runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: actualbudget/actions/setup@main
    - name: Check release notes
      env:
        PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      shell: bash
      run: node actions/release-notes/check/index.js
